literature_notes: The sole ledger entry [L1] describes a murine CSF2Rα His-tagged construct cloned into pCAGGS and expressed in HEK293T cells. It fails on two independent grounds. First, the tag position is entirely unstated: the quote names only 'pCAGGS-CSF2Rα (His-tagged)' with no residue, no primer table, and no prose locating the junction — exactly the disqualifying condition 'a commercial plasmid whose tag POSITION is unstated; you cannot pin insert_after_residue.' Second, because neither N-terminal nor C-terminal placement is specified, topology-derived reasoning cannot rescue it: CSF2RA is a Type I single-pass receptor whose N-terminus (after SP cleavage, residue 23) is extracellular and whose C-terminus (residue 400) is intracellular, so the two termini face opposite compartments and the unknown placement cannot be resolved to a unique extracellular junction. Even setting those problems aside, the construct is a murine ortholog (indirect evidence at best) and the only functional readout reported is co-immunoprecipitation, which does not confirm surface display. No other ledger lines exist. Zero sites qualify, which is the correct answer.
